verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm offering legal advisory services plus a few client-facing document-automation tools (SCC and Term Sheet generators, a HighQ-hosted deal room). Webhook event subscriptions are a software-platform axis, not one a buyer comparing law firms would reasonably ask about. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships registrable outbound HTTP callbacks; the Docusign integration is a different feature and is not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
